fields.summary: Integrate Okta with Google for SSO + user/group provisioning
fields.description: Integrate Okta with Google Cloud Identity / Google Workspace for Single Sign-On (SAML) and user/group provisioning (SCIM). Configure Google integration in Okta, set NameID to user email, and map groups if group-based entitlements are required.

fields.summary: Pentest High - Password age on krbtgt (built-in account)
fields.description: Remediate aged krbtgt password in Active Directory. Finding notes that the krbtgt password was last changed on May 17, 2015 and recommends double rotation with replication validation, testing, and semiannual governance thereafter.

fields.summary: Help to Configure OKTA Group for SmartComm Cloud Access in ClaimCenter
fields.description: Set up and configure Okta groups for managing SmartComm Cloud access in ClaimCenter for interactive users. Group should have both '02-Templates User' and '13-Operations User' roles. Ticket references attached user list for Prod and NonProd access.
Disable TLS 1.0/1.1 and enable TLS 1.2/1.3. Notes indicate issues appear related to UCS KVMs.

fields.summary: CS-5763 Create OKTA Groups for SmartComm Cloud Access (Prod and NonProd)
fields.description: Create two Okta groups for SmartComm Cloud Interactive users: SG-Okta_SmartComm-Prod-Interactive and SG-Okta_SmartComm-NonProd-Interactive.

fields.summary: CS-5763 Configure SmartComm Cloud Roles for OKTA Groups
fields.description: Assign both '02-Templates User' and '13-Operations User' roles to the OKTA groups within SmartComm Cloud.

fields.summary: CS-5763 Document OKTA Group Configuration and Access Levels
fields.description: Document configuration steps, access levels, permissions, roles, and responsibilities for each Okta group for audit and future reference.

fields.summary: Coordinate and Remove Legacy Microsoft Office 2010 Software from Identified Production Virtual Servers
fields.description: Coordinate with device owners for AUS-VMPROD12 and AUS-VMQA16, secure approval, schedule uninstallation of Office 2010 components, validate removal, communicate completion, and update records. If business dependencies exist, coordinate on newer versions or selective uninstall.

fields.summary: 3.2 Google Admin Console: enable SSO with Okta as IdP
fields.description: Enable Single Sign-On in Google Admin Console using Okta as the identity provider. Configure third-party SSO, upload IdP certificate, set sign-in, sign-out, and password URLs as applicable, and test with a pilot group.

fields.summary: Pentest High - Data exposure via SMB
fields.description: Sensitive information exposure through multiple SMB shares, including backups, source code, and plaintext credentials. Remediation includes enforcing least-privilege access, removing broad groups from share/NTFS permissions, and tightening governance around exposed shares.
